clips.title: The story
paras: At Maestra's Post, Sentinel Onaeya guards the northern edge of Ashenvale. The night elf guardian rallies Alliance adventurers to protect the forest and aid fellow sentinels.

Maestra's Post is a wayside outpost on the road from Darkshore into Ashenvale. Sentinel Onaeya guards the lodge outside the settlement and coordinates its defense. Hostile wildlife, corrupting forces, and border tensions threaten night elf settlements in the region.

Sentinel Onaeya hears that Sentinel Aynasha was attacked by furbolgs while carrying an important message through Darkshore. Onaeya rewards those who protect the poisoned sentinel until her antidote takes effect.
